title: Route BitMatrix::mul row-XOR through xor_fn dispatch
description:
## Current

`BitMatrix::mul` non-M4RM path at `crates/gf2-core/src/matrix.rs:1165+` uses scalar inner-product per `(r,c)` pair. The AVX2 XOR kernel (`LogicalFns::xor_fn`) already exists but the row accumulation here does not call it.

## Fix

Refactor the non-M4RM path so row-XOR accumulation goes through `simd::maybe_simd().xor_fn` for rows above a width threshold (reuse the threshold tuning approach from `m4rm_components.rs`).

## PPC steps

V0 baseline (`matmul` bench) → V3 dispatch → asm verify (`vpxor` mnemonic in inner loop).

## Per-kernel execution protocol

Same as A1.

## Depends on

I1, I2, I3, I4.

## Success criteria

- [hard] Existing matmul tests + word-boundary `#[test]`s pass.
- [hard] Proptest equivalence vs. scalar.
- [hard] M4RM path crossover unchanged (this task touches the non-M4RM fallback only).
- [aspirational] ≥1.5× at design size class.
